subject: Request: Early-career sign-on + mid-cycle equity refresh approval (candidate: Priya S.)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Early-career sign-on + equity refresh for Priya Singh

Team —

Quick one: we have a strong SDE2 candidate, Priya Singh, who is final-stage and holding a counteroffer from a fintech startup. Priya would own the new KV-cache optimization work (LLM inference performance lane) and would be the sole IC pairing with the infra team for the next 6 months. Hiring manager asks that we extend an out-of-band sign-on and a mid-cycle equity refresh to make the offer competitive.

Current approved band for SDE2: base $130,000, eq target 0.15%. Proposed (manager ask):
- Base: $145,000 (out-of-band)
- Sign-on: $15,000 one-time
- Equity refresh: +0.25% (one-time refresh, 4-year schedule)
- Vesting note: front-loaded 6-month cliff on 25% if accepted within 5 business days

Rationale (high level):
- Candidate has prior work shipping attention-kernel optimizations that materially improved throughput (measured 20–35% improvement)
- Hard-to-source skill set — public benchmark shows <5 people in market with direct experience
- Hiring timeline: team needs an onboarded IC by early April to hit Q2 delivery commitments

I know this is outside normal bands. Can you advise on whether Comp/People can approve an exception, and if so what the authorized ceilings would be? I’ve attached a draft term sheet and Priya’s resume for context.

Attachments: 20260218-priya-singh-term-sheet-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Early-career sign-on + equity refresh for Priya Singh

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the quick context. A few things we need before Comp can approve an exception:

1) Business justification bullets that map to measurable outcomes (we need specifics we can include in the approval):
   - Which projects will Priya own, milestone dates, and success metrics (throughput, latency, customer impact)
2) Headcount status: is this an open, approved HC? Is it backfill or net-new? Please include budget code (if any).
3) Can the manager confirm the absolute maximum ask (not preferred) so Comp can evaluate ceilings; right now you listed a proposed ask — specify your ‘must-have’ vs ‘nice-to-have’.

For transparency: our usual levers for exceptions are: limited sign-on (one-time, taxable), equity refresh capped to 0.2% for early-career in rare cases, or base uplift up to +10% over band only with VP approval. If you want more than that we will need an org-level exception which takes longer.

I’ve attached the comp-band-authorization template — fill and return and I’ll route to VP People for a decision.

Attachments: comp-band-authorization.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Early-career sign-on + equity refresh for Priya Singh

Laura —

Thanks. Below are the specifics you requested; I’ve filled the comp-band template and attached an updated term sheet.

Business impact / ownership (concrete):
- Primary owner of KV-cache optimization (Project: fast-kv-q2) — milestones:
  • 2026-04-01: baseline + profiling complete
  • 2026-05-15: prototype shipped (expected 12–18% token latency reduction)
  • 2026-06-30: rollout to staging + performance regression <5%
- Expected throughput improvement: estimated 10–18% unit cost reduction for high-seq workloads (customer-facing); if realized, reduces infra spend per 1M tokens by ~9%
- Mentorship: will accelerate onboarding of two junior infra engineers (reduces ramp by ~4 weeks each)

Headcount: This is net-new, FY26 approved HC (code: ENG-INF-26-NW). Budget is allocated.

Must-have vs nice-to-have:
- Must-have: sign-on >= $12,000 OR base uplift to $140,000 (whichever is preferred by Comp)
- Nice-to-have: sign-on up to $15,000 and equity refresh up to +0.25%

We’re time sensitive — candidate has a deadline from the other offer on Friday 02/26. If we can get a quick decision we’ll proceed to verbal and DocuSign.

Attachments: 20260219-priya-term-sheet-revA.pdf, comp-band-authorization-filled.pdf

Thanks for prioritizing — happy to hop on a quick 15-min sync if helpful.

—Markus

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T15:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Early-career sign-on + equity refresh for Priya Singh

Markus / Jonas —

Appreciate the fast follow-up and the filled template. After reviewing with VP People and calibrating to other recent SDE2 hires, we will approve a one-time discretionary exception with the following limits and conditions:

Approval (final):
- Sign-on: $12,000 one-time (taxable)
- Base uplift: approve to $140,000 (not the full $145k requested) — manager may choose sign-on OR base uplift, not both in full.
- Equity refresh: +0.18% (one-time refresh, standard 4-year vesting).
- Vesting cliff: standard schedule; the 6-month front-load cannot be applied to refresh grants.

Conditions:
- Offer must be extended and accepted (DocuSign) by 2026-02-24 23:59 PT
- Offer paperwork must include the business justification summary (for audit) and the comp-band-authorization.pdf attached
- This exception is a single-case approval and cannot be used as precedent for other hires without VP sign-off

I’ve attached the signed comp-band-authorization and a DocuSign envelope link for the approved term sheet. Please coordinate with Vanessa to get verbal sign-off to Priya and move to DocuSign.

Attachments: comp-band-authorization.pdf
Related link: https://redwood.company/docusign/SSO-4267

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

On a process note: Jonas — please ask Recruiting to track this in HubSpot and tag the record with "exception-approved" so our compensation audit can reconcile later.
